items.name: dot-orb
items.title: Dot orb
items.description: An interactive dot orb that reacts to your microphone or an audio file.

thumbnail.alt: A purple and white dot orb changing shape in a dark dot field.

items.name: state-buttons
items.title: State buttons
items.description: A customizable button for loading, thinking, pending, success and error states.

thumbnail.alt: A dark button labeled Thinking with a red light matrix rippling outward.

items.name: inline-download
items.title: Inline download
items.description: A download button that fills with progress, counts up, then offers Open.

thumbnail.alt: A light download pill on black, part-filled with progress and counting up.

items.name: eyespice
items.title: EyeSpice
items.description: A textured 3D eye that follows your cursor and closes when you get too close.

thumbnail.alt: A textured monochrome 3D eye with a dark iris and bright silhouette rim.

items.name: interactive-art
items.title: Interactive art
items.description: A growing lotus garden with flexible stems, a day and night cycle, and PNG layer exports.

thumbnail.alt: White and purple lotus flowers growing above a pond in daylight.

items.name: root-infection
items.title: Root Infection
items.description: Stay still. Roots grow from your cursor and spread across the page.

thumbnail.alt: Maroon roots branching from the cursor across a dark page.

items.name: nilkamal
items.title: Nilkamal
items.description: A blue lotus on a living pond. Rain, storms, snow, and ice change the scene.

thumbnail.alt: A blue lotus and its reflection on a moonlit pond in the rain.

items.name: diwali-26
items.title: Diwali/26
items.description: Lotus rangoli beneath a night sky. Launch floral bursts, DIWALI and 2026 with a click.

thumbnail.alt: Flowers, leafy paisleys, marigold garlands and diyas beneath skyshots in a dark Diwali sky.

items.name: textured-glass
items.title: Textured glass
items.description: Textured glass with image depth, mouse parallax, and adjustable focus.

thumbnail.alt: A photograph seen through rough glass with a fine square grid and a broad light reflection.

items.name: liquid-glass
items.title: Liquid Glass
items.description: A WebGL lens that refracts, reflects, and softens typography or images beneath the glass.

thumbnail.alt: Liquid Glass refracting the word Color on a pale background.

items.name: elastic-slider
items.title: Elastic slider
items.description: A bounded slider with elastic endpoint stretch, rigid content, and interruptible settling.

thumbnail.alt: A vertical brightness slider stretching beyond its endpoint on a pale background.

items.name: snap-rail
items.title: Snap rail
items.description: A draggable rail with velocity-projected detents and continuous spring retargeting.

thumbnail.alt: A rounded draggable marker settling between labeled rail positions.

items.name: liquid-cluster
items.title: Apple Liquid Cluster
items.description: A notification that splits into a card and Clear button through a liquid seam.

thumbnail.alt: A notification rectangle separating into a message card and Clear button.

items.name: logo-refraction
items.title: Logo refraction
items.description: Metallic light across the black field, with an iridescent sweep and outline glint on the n.

thumbnail.alt: The complete square maynkudu logo, with metallic light on its black field and an iridescent n in the lower right.

items.name: overlay-navigation
items.title: Overlay navigation
items.description: A fixed navbar and full-screen menu with rolling labels, image previews, and coordinated transitions.

thumbnail.alt: The portfolio navbar above a light navigation panel and abstract image previews.

items.name: liquid-animations
items.title: Liquid Animations
items.description: Menus, tooltips and controls with liquid growth, rigid content and interruptible motion.

thumbnail.alt: A liquid Account menu growing from a round avatar on a dark background.

items.name: liquid-text-reveal
items.title: Liquid Text Reveal
items.description: Colored liquid shapes resolve into sharp text as you scroll. Scroll back to reverse the reveal.

thumbnail.alt: Text on warm paper with sharp letters on the left and liquid red letters on the right.

items.name: multi-step-download
items.title: Multi-step download
items.description: A circular download button with an expanding progress ring, a moving arrow and a green success check.

thumbnail.alt: A raised circular download button with a clockwise black progress ring on a pale background.

items.name: brick-noise
items.title: Brick noise
items.description: A staggered grayscale grid with a repeating wave of tile brightness.

thumbnail.alt: Staggered grayscale tiles separated by thin black lines.

items.name: portrait-wave
items.title: Portrait wave
items.description: Portraits morph through a diagonal wave of tiles. Supply your own image array.

thumbnail.alt: Two grayscale portraits morphing through diagonally delayed rectangular tiles.

items.name: halftone
items.title: Halftone
items.description: Flowing light on a dot grid, with an eased liquid trail that follows your pointer.

thumbnail.alt: Copper and cream dots tracing flowing light and a soft pointer trail on a dark background.

items.name: image-mosaic
items.title: Image mosaic
items.description: A photo becomes a periodic-table mosaic, with metallic light, refraction and a comparison slider.

thumbnail.alt: A horse-sculpture photograph compared with its metallic periodic-table mosaic.

items.name: thermal-image
items.title: Thermal image
items.description: Moving bands of thermal color follow a rotatable 3D car or an uploaded image.

thumbnail.alt: A 3D GT3 RS turning beneath moving thermal bands.

items.name: porsche-gt3rs
items.title: Porsche GT3RS
items.description: A configurable 992 GT3 RS with a dark studio floor, softbox reflections, paint colors and wheel finishes.

thumbnail.alt: The olive Porsche GT3RS turning under studio lights.

items.description: 2048 with grayscale tiles, animated score meters, and merge sounds.

thumbnail.alt: Grayscale 2048 tiles beneath score and best meters on an almost-white background.

items.name: sprite-racer
items.title: Switchback
items.description: A sprite-stacked driving game with six cars, five circuits and a drift yard.

thumbnail.alt: A pixel car driving on a raised road through a layered forest world.

items.name: cube-archive
items.title: Cube Archive
items.description: A portfolio page where projects turn through a cube selector and open into full-width case views.

thumbnail.alt: Portfolio images turning through a cube selector before opening as a wide project case.
